title: Conditional Error Exponents of Probabilistic Quantum Resource Distillation
summary: Quantum resource distillation converts imperfect resource states into highly resourceful targets and is a central task in quantum information processing. When distillation is probabilistic, unfavorable outcomes may be discarded and the quality of the output is evaluated conditioned on success, leading to a notion of reliability that differs from the deterministic setting.
